Can I file ITR 4 instructions if I have freelance income? Yes, if you are a professional with freelance income (like in graphic designing, writing, consulting, etc.), and your income is under ?50 lakh, you can file ITR-4 under Section 44ADA. What if my income is more than ?50 lakh? If your total income exceeds ?50 lakh, then you have to file ITR-3 or any other applicable forms and can't file ITR-4. Is it mandatory to e-verify ITR-4 after filing? Yes, the form must be e-verified post-submission by way of Aadhaar OTP, net banking, or by sending a physical ITR-V to CPC Bengaluru. sections.heading: Section 7
paragraphs: Filing Income Tax Returns (ITR) is one of the utmost responsibilities placed on taxpayers in India. Among the various forms enumerated by the Income Tax Department, the ITR-4 form holds immense significance for an individual opting for the presumptive taxation scheme. Thus, knowing the ITR-4 will assist small business owners, professionals, and freelancers in filling their forms correctly.

This information by Services Plus tries to shed some light on everything you should know about the ITR-4 Form: its purpose, eligibility, instructions, tax computation, documentation, procedure of filing, and penalties for non-filing. Whether it is ITR 4 instructions you are looking for or filling out the ITR form online in India, this guide is all you need.
The ITR-4 form is a return filing form that is meant for:
This would enable such taxpayers to file their income tax return on a presumptive tax basis without having to maintain books of accounts in detail.
The ITR-4 Form covers income for:
Income from Business under Section 44AD or 44AE
Income from other sources (not including lottery winnings, racehorse income, etc.)

Can I file ITR 4 instructions if I have freelance income?
Yes, if you are a professional with freelance income (like in graphic designing, writing, consulting, etc.), and your income is under ?50 lakh, you can file ITR-4 under Section 44ADA.
What if my income is more than ?50 lakh?
If your total income exceeds ?50 lakh, then you have to file ITR-3 or any other applicable forms and can't file ITR-4.
Is it mandatory to e-verify ITR-4 after filing?
Yes, the form must be e-verified post-submission by way of Aadhaar OTP, net banking, or by sending a physical ITR-V to CPC Bengaluru.
Can I claim deductions under Chapter VI-A in ITR-4?
Yes, deductions like 80C, 80D, 80G, etc., can be claimed under Chapter VI-A even while filing ITR- 4.
Is an audit required if I file ITR Form online in India under presumptive taxation?
No audit under Section 44AB would be applicable if you are filing ITR-4 under presumptive taxation and your turnover is within limits.
